description: This Java source file defines the GZIPFilter class, a servlet filter used within the OpenMRS web application to handle gzip compression of responses. It intercepts HTTP requests, determines gzip support, potentially wraps requests/responses with gzip wrappers, and manages enabling/disabling based on global properties.

classes.name: GZIPFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter for compressing HTTP responses with gzip if supported by the client and enabled in global properties.

methods.name: doFilterInternal
methods.description: Main filter method invoked for each request; applies gzip compression if supported and enabled.

methods.name: performGZIPRequest
methods.description: Wraps incoming request in a gzip wrapper if the 'Content-encoding' header indicates gzip.

methods.name: isGZIPSupported
methods.description: Checks if the client supports gzip encoding based on request headers.

methods.name: isGZIPEnabled
methods.description: Checks global configuration to determine if gzip compression is enabled.

methods.name: isCompressedRequestForPathAccepted
methods.description: Determines if the request path is configured to accept gzip compression based on global settings.
